perspective:
From Bradley Ochoa’s available perspective:

- He is Bradley Ochoa, a Hispanic man and salesperson at a marketing firm; he has a high school education. He knows Katherine Lasiloo as a colleague and marketing manager. Their professional relationship is generally cordial but sometimes strained by differing views on sales vs. marketing.
- In the meeting room, he had prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns to support his belief that traditional sales techniques are being overlooked. He told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but believed core sales would benefit more from traditional methods. He heard her respond that the market is evolving, digital outreach cannot be ignored, and she asked how he reconciles his data with rising online engagement. He replied that he was not suggesting abandoning digital, but felt proven methods were being sidelined without proper consideration. He heard her propose analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shared recent digital campaign success stories that had boosted engagement and sales. He found the results impressive and asked how those strategies are developed. She explained it is about targeting the right audience with the right message and offered to walk him through the analytics and decision-making. He admitted he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods but now wanted to understand digital more. She said she was glad he was open and that adapting to market trends matters.
- He proposed a joint strategy session to combine traditional and digital approaches. Katherine agreed, saying combining strengths could lead to better results and suggesting they schedule brainstorming. He said he was hopeful and appreciated her willingness to collaborate. She said she looked forward to leveraging each other’s strengths.
- After the joint meeting, he was excited and worked overtime on a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He told Katherine about the draft. She reviewed it, praised it as comprehensive and well thought out, and noted his hard work. He said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart and wanted to nail the presentation. She was confident and suggested reviewing and fine-tuning once more.
- After the presentation and implementation, he felt grateful for his professional growth and their successful collaboration. He thanked Katherine and said he learned a lot. She said it was a pleasure seeing the project come to fruition and that his openness to new ideas made it a successful partnership. He proposed regular strategy sessions to keep momentum. She agreed, saying it would keep them on top of their game and market trends.

He has no access to Katherine’s private background, education, personality type, or any events or information he did not personally observe, hear, or participate in.
